checks.detail: Frontend, native, Rust and project authorities identify v6.0.1.
World pointer and camera bounds are serialized and exposed through matching Rhai documentation/runtime bindings.
Replay and network-replay input preserve the new deterministic pointer data with legacy fallbacks.
The localized launcher template owns a native fixed-step pointer player, grouped target prefab, timer-bounded manager and UI content.
The starter bounds pointer impulses, stops outside the Game viewport, and avoids rebuilding physics for UI-only mutations.
Runtime prefabs and scene instances preserve editor selection and batch physics invalidation, preventing first-tick stalls.
Script tracing uses a WebAssembly-safe clock and the bridge surfaces precise panic locations.
Project Format 2 accepts current Rhai API v2 assets and legacy API v1 assets, protected by a native regression test.
HTML and three Markdown manuals contain a clear trilingual game tutorial and a live article controller.
Template identity and release labels are complete in English, German and Chinese.
Game and manual verification passes while external claims remain pending.
Generic packaging and verification retain the exact eleven-artifact contract.
